xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4644: Import VS Code themes and support custom color themes in the dashboard

plan.title: Import VS Code themes and support custom color themes in the dashboard
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One color-theme pipeline spans the shared contracts model, the server store/config/tmux stamp, four routes, and the frontend consumers (terminal, chat syntax, UI tokens, pickers, import); the no-loss matrix (tests/unit) and the frontend CI test list (package.json) are mandatory touch points, and each doc file counts as its own subsystem. The separable entry points (.vsix import #4659, editor UI #4660) were already split into sibling issues; what remains is the minimum end-to-end feature — removing any consumer would leave a selectable theme that does nothing visible.

narratives.Problem: The dashboard has a light/dark mode and a design language (Ledger/Broadsheet) but no way to change colors. The terminal palette and the tmux OSC 11 background are hardcoded pairs, chat code blocks always use github-light, and there is no way to import a VS Code theme or define a custom one.
narratives.Proposal: Add a color theme model (name, type, optional terminal/syntax/ui groups) in @overdeck/contracts with two built-ins that carry today's palettes; store user themes in ~/.overdeck/themes/<id>.json; store the per-mode selection in config.yaml ui.color_theme.{light,dark} with warn-and-fallback resolution; import single VS Code theme .json files (JSONC) through a preview route; apply the active theme to xterm.js, the tmux window-style stamp, chat syntax highlighting (content-hashed registered shiki themes) and a fenced UI token subset; add light/dark pickers and an import preview to Settings > Appearance. Full design: .pan/drafts/PAN-4644.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- .vsix import (moved to #4659) and the duplicate-and-edit theme editor UI (moved to #4660)
- A Herdr background stamp; COLORFGBG and launcher-generator.ts stay unchanged
- Diff viewer syntax colors (stay pierre-dark / pierre-light)
- Deleting or renaming themes from the UI
- Overriding signal or state colors (--state-*, --success*, --warning*, --destructive*, --info*, --signal-*), fonts, density, radius, or chat width
- Curated built-in themes beyond overdeck-dark and overdeck-light
- Recoloring already-running tmux sessions
- VS Code include resolution and .tmTheme token files for single-file import
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap or growing src/lib/tmux.ts or src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts

autoDecisions.summary: Split .vsix import into #4659 and the duplicate-and-edit editor into #4660; edited the PAN-4644 body with a scope note
autoDecisions.rationale: The core alone exceeds the plan surface lint (37 files, 8 subsystems); both are independent entry points onto this issue's store and import route and can pass review and UAT on their own.

autoDecisions.summary: Register theme syntax with @pierre/diffs registerCustomTheme under a content-hashed name
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified registerCustomTheme exists and refuses duplicate names; hashing makes edited or re-imported themes take effect.

autoDecisions.summary: No Herdr background stamp in this issue
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified no stamp exists in src/lib/terminal-backends and herdr pane/tab expose no color option; COLORFGBG already gives Claude Code light/dark for both backends.

autoDecisions.summary: UI group uses the issue's six keys but never overrides signal/state tokens; ui.foreground reads editor.foreground before foreground
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the pan-style-guide color law; VS Code foreground is dim chrome text in many themes (Ayu Dark #5a6378).

autoDecisions.summary: Missing terminal colors fall back to the built-in palette of the same type, with no panel.background inference
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue states this rule and its acceptance criterion depends on it.

autoDecisions.summary: Each mode slot accepts only themes of its type
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the mode-based COLORFGBG consistent with the active theme without touching launcher-generator.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Add jsonc-parser as a root dependency
autoDecisions.rationale: VS Code themes allow comments and trailing commas; no JSONC parser is installed and hand-rolled stripping is error-prone.

autoDecisions.summary: Upload as JSON { fileName, contentBase64 } with a 2 MB cap
autoDecisions.rationale: No multipart handling exists in dashboard routes; theme files are small.

autoDecisions.summary: Diff viewer keeps pierre themes; only chat code blocks and the file-link quickview follow the theme syntax
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue acceptance criteria name chat code blocks; diff colors depend on pierre theme internals.

autoDecisions.summary: Fixtures are Ayu Dark and Ayu Light (vscode-ayu, MIT) generated from @shikijs/themes
autoDecisions.rationale: Both define terminal.background/foreground and all 16 ANSI keys (verified); GitHub Default themes lack terminal.background.

autoDecisions.summary: Selection resolved server-side from config.yaml + ui-theme.json mode + theme files; the frontend never writes on load
autoDecisions.rationale: State is derived where possible, and a fresh browser profile cannot clobber the operator's selection.

items.title: Add the color theme model and built-in themes to @overdeck/contracts

narrative.Action: Follow PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4644.md "Theme file shape", "Validation rules", "Effective values" and work item 1. Create packages/contracts/src/color-theme.ts exporting the types ColorTheme (wire: file fields + id + builtin), ColorThemeFile, TerminalPalette (21 keys: background, foreground, cursor, cursorAccent, selectionBackground, black..brightWhite), ColorThemeUi (background, surface, border, foreground, muted, accent), ColorThemeSyntax ({ colors?: { editor.background?, editor.foreground? }, tokenColors }), ColorThemesListResponse, ColorThemeImportPreviewResponse; constants COLOR_THEME_ID_RE = /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/, RESERVED_COLOR_THEME_IDS = [overdeck-dark, overdeck-light], BUILTIN_COLOR_THEMES (overdeck-dark and overdeck-light whose terminal palettes are copied byte-for-byte from src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/XTerminal.tsx xtermTheme(), no syntax, no ui); functions builtinFor(type), normalizeColorTheme(raw, id) returning { theme, warnings } or { errors }, effectiveTerminalPalette(theme), toOpaqueHex(hex), readableForeground(hex), slugifyThemeId(name). Export everything from packages/contracts/src/index.ts. Pure TypeScript, no Node or DOM imports.

The id is the file name and is not stored in the file. Tests use a temp OVERDECK_HOME.

Parse ui.color_theme in config.yaml and keep it through general settings saves

Fix any typing fallout of the new normalized field (e.g. the ui merge at ~:1118). Do not add lines past the file-size allowance (settings-api.ts 1508, merge.ts 1045, schema.ts 1114).

Leave launcher-generator.ts and COLORFGBG untouched. Update the ui-theme.ts doc comment so TERMINAL_BG is described as the fallback and points at BUILTIN_COLOR_THEMES instead of XTERM_BG; rename the ui-theme.test.ts case "exposes pane backgrounds matching the frontend XTERM_BG values" to compare TERMINAL_BG against BUILTIN_COLOR_THEMES terminal backgrounds.

items.title: Given mode dark and ui.color_theme.dark ayu-dark saved with terminal.background #0d1017, resolveTerminalBackground returns #0d1017

Map a VS Code theme JSON file to a color theme

narrative.Action: PRD "VS Code mapping" table and rules, "Fixture generation". Add jsonc-parser ^3.3.1 to root package.json dependencies (bun install updates bun.lock). mapVsCodeTheme(text, fileName) parses with jsonc-parser parse(text, errors, { allowTrailingComma: true }), throws ColorThemeImportError naming the first error offset, maps keys exactly per the table (ui.foreground = editor.foreground ?? foreground), derives type per the PRD rule, warns on include and on string tokenColors, then runs normalizeColorTheme. It never fills fallback colors into the result. Generate fixtures ayu-dark.jsonc and ayu-light.jsonc from @shikijs/themes with the PRD command (keep the attribution comment line); hand-write no-terminal.jsonc with a comment and a trailing comma.

Add the useColorTheme store that applies the active theme

narrative.Action: PRD "Frontend modules" useColorTheme.ts bullet and the UI token table. Zustand store with themes, selection, warnings, loaded; reconcileFromServer() (GET /api/color-themes, apply, mirror), select(mode, id) (PUT with dashboardMutationJsonHeaders(), then apply), previewImport(file) (reads the File as base64, POST import/preview), saveImported(theme) (POST /api/color-themes, then reconcile); selectors activeTheme(mode) and terminalPalette(mode) (effectiveTerminalPalette). Mirror { light, dark } themes in localStorage key overdeck.ui.colorThemes.active with every access in try/catch; default to built-ins. Subscribe to useTheme so a mode toggle re-applies UI tokens. applyUiTokens implements the token table exactly, removes every property it set before applying the next theme, and never sets signal/state tokens. No server write on load. main.tsx calls reconcileFromServer() after the design-language reconcile.
